website_published.help: Set if the application is published on the website of the company.
website_published.name: website_published

website_url.help: The full relative URL to access the document through the website.
website_url.name: website_url

website_absolute_url.help: The full absolute URL to access the document through the website.
website_absolute_url.name: website_absolute_url

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.
activity_state.name: activity_state

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.
activity_exception_decoration.name: activity_exception_decoration

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.
activity_exception_icon.name: activity_exception_icon

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.name: message_needaction

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.name: message_has_error

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.name: message_has_error_counter

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.name: message_has_sms_error

expected_employees.help: Expected number of employees for this job position after new recruitment.
expected_employees.name: expected_employees

no_of_employee.help: Number of employees currently occupying this job position.
no_of_employee.name: no_of_employee

no_of_recruitment.help: Number of new employees you expect to recruit.
no_of_recruitment.name: no_of_recruitment

user_id.help: The Recruiter will be the default value for all Applicants in this job             position. The Recruiter is automatically added to all meetings with the Applicant.
user_id.name: user_id

alias_id.help: Email alias for this job position. New emails will automatically create new applicants for this job position.
alias_id.name: alias_id

alias_name.help: The name of the email alias, e.g. 'jobs' if you want to catch emails for <jobs@example.odoo.com>
alias_name.name: alias_name

alias_defaults.help: A Python dictionary that will be evaluated to provide default values when creating new records for this alias.
alias_defaults.name: alias_defaults

address_id.help: Select the location where the applicant will work. Addresses listed here are defined on the company's contact information.
address_id.name: address_id

open_application_count.help: Number of applications that are still ongoing (not hired or refused)
open_application_count.name: open_application_count

new_application_count.help: Number of applications that are new in the flow (typically at first step of the flow)
new_application_count.name: new_application_count

interviewer_ids.help: The Interviewers set on the job position can see all Applicants in it. They have access to the information, the attachments, the meeting management and they can refuse him. You don't need to have Recruitment rights to be set as an interviewer.
interviewer_ids.name: interviewer_ids

no_of_hired_employee.help: Number of hired employees for this job position during recruitment phase.
no_of_hired_employee.name: no_of_hired_employee

job_details.help: Complementary information that will appear on the job submission page
job_details.name: job_details

alias_model_id.help: The model (Odoo Document Kind) to which this alias corresponds. Any incoming email that does not reply to an existing record will cause the creation of a new record of this model (e.g. a Project Task)
alias_model_id.name: alias_model_id

alias_force_thread_id.help: Optional ID of a thread (record) to which all incoming messages will be attached, even if they did not reply to it. If set, this will disable the creation of new records completely.
alias_force_thread_id.name: alias_force_thread_id

alias_parent_model_id.help: Parent model holding the alias. The model holding the alias reference is not necessarily the model given by alias_model_id (example: project (parent_model) and task (model))
alias_parent_model_id.name: alias_parent_model_id

alias_parent_thread_id.help: ID of the parent record holding the alias (example: project holding the task creation alias)
alias_parent_thread_id.name: alias_parent_thread_id

alias_contact.help:
Policy to post a message on the document using the mailgateway.
- everyone: everyone can post
- partners: only authenticated partners
- followers: only followers of the related document or members of following channels
alias_contact.name: alias_contact

alias_bounced_content.help: If set, this content will automatically be sent out to unauthorized users instead of the default message.
alias_bounced_content.name: alias_bounced_content

alias_status.help: Alias status assessed on the last message received.
alias_status.name: alias_status
